acceptanceCriteria: run receipt with both operands empty yields VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY and the run is not credited as a witness
static unseeded-collection count assertion flagged with a suggested precondition; seeded fixture not flagged
drifted row citation reported against the pinned commit; absent operands or commit abstain
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#1193. Run-time: when a run receipt captures assertion operands, flag an equality/count assertion whose both sides are empty or zero as VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY for that run, and do not count the run as a witness for the bound row. Static: flag count/equality assertions against a collection the bound fixture does not seed, suggesting a non-empty precondition. Related: report row citations (file:line) that no longer point at the cited symbol at the row's pinned commit.
title: GH #1193: VACUOUS-EMPTY-EQUALITY - equality/count assertions passing on empty collections, plus row citation line drift
